verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents connecting a GitHub repository for automatic PR reviews, which is a real third-party integration, but the evidence pack shows only this single integration (no Slack, Jira, or other common PM tools) and no detail on setup being 'a few clicks' beyond generic 'connect a repository' language. missing for 10: evidence of multiple common third-party tool integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Linear), and concrete UI/setup-flow proof of a quick, low-friction connection process.
